answer: A hostile operator thus cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. The wander schedule is applied in falcon and ledge makes public each instalment. A payout is split and as a result 40% arrives at settlement and the rest over 15 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 2535 identities would post 1832 proofs and burn roughly 63 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
